subject: en_read
source: English National Curriculum — English programmes of study: key stage 1 (Year 1 reading: word reading and comprehension), DfE 2013

weeks.topic: Reading for pleasure: exploring the class library
objectives: Choose a book to enjoy from the class library
Handle books carefully and turn pages in order

weeks.topic: Wordless picture books: telling the story from pictures (e.g. Journey)
objectives: Tell a story using only the pictures
Notice details in illustrations

weeks.topic: Nursery rhymes: joining in with rhyme and rhythm
objectives: Join in with familiar nursery rhymes
Spot the rhyming words

weeks.topic: Patterned stories: Brown Bear, Brown Bear, What Do You See?
objectives: Join in with predictable phrases
Use the pattern to read along

weeks.topic: Phonically decodable books: blending to read aloud
objectives: Sound out and blend unfamiliar words
Re-read books to build fluency

weeks.topic: Stories about feelings: The Colour Monster
objectives: Name feelings in a story
Link the character's feelings to my own

weeks.topic: Traditional tales: The Gingerbread Man and its refrain
objectives: Join in with the repeated refrain
Retell the story in order

weeks.topic: Stories about home and family: Owl Babies
objectives: Link the story to my own experiences
Talk about how the owlets feel

weeks.topic: Non-fiction: animal books with pictures and captions
objectives: Find facts in pictures and captions
Tell the difference between stories and fact books

weeks.topic: Fairy stories: Little Red Riding Hood
objectives: Talk about good and bad characters
Retell key events of the story

weeks.topic: Poems to learn by heart: counting rhymes
objectives: Learn a short counting rhyme by heart
Recite it with actions

weeks.topic: Julia Donaldson: The Gruffalo — predicting from the cover
objectives: Predict what a story is about from the cover and title
Check my prediction while reading

weeks.topic: Stories from other cultures: Handa's Surprise
objectives: Talk about a story set in Kenya
Compare the setting with my own

weeks.topic: Celebration stories: listening and retelling
objectives: Listen to stories about festivals around the world
Retell a favourite part

weeks.topic: Review: favourite stories and rhymes from Term 1
objectives: Retell a favourite story from Term 1
Recite a rhyme learnt by heart

weeks.topic: Stories with a problem and solution: Dogger
objectives: Find the problem and how it is solved
Talk about how the characters feel

weeks.topic: Animal stories: Elmer — being different
objectives: Discuss why Elmer wants to be the same
Talk about the message of the story

weeks.topic: Rhyming stories: Oi Frog!
objectives: Spot rhyming words in a funny story
Predict the next rhyme

weeks.topic: Non-fiction: using a contents page and pictures
objectives: Use a contents page to find a section
Find information about the human body

weeks.topic: Traditional tales: The Three Billy Goats Gruff
objectives: Retell the story in the right order
Use character voices for the troll and goats

weeks.topic: Funny stories: Mr Gumpy's Outing
objectives: Talk about what makes a story funny
Remember what each animal promised

weeks.topic: Reading aloud with expression
objectives: Read aloud using different voices
Pause at full stops and change voice for questions

weeks.topic: Nonsense poems: playing with words
objectives: Enjoy funny and nonsense poems
Find made-up words and talk about them

weeks.topic: Friendship stories: Frog and Toad Are Friends
objectives: Talk about how friends help each other
Read short chapters with support

weeks.topic: Fables: The Hare and the Tortoise
objectives: Explain the lesson of a fable
Talk about whether the characters were wise

weeks.topic: Space stories: Whatever Next!
objectives: Tell real from imaginary events in a story
Find facts about space in a non-fiction book

weeks.topic: Mid-year reading assessment
objectives: Read a decodable text aloud accurately
Answer simple questions about a story

weeks.topic: Adventure stories: We're Going on a Bear Hunt
objectives: Join in with repeated phrases and sound words
Retell the journey in order

weeks.topic: Stories about growing: Jack and the Beanstalk
objectives: Retell the key events
Talk about Jack's choices

weeks.topic: Under the sea: The Snail and the Whale and ocean facts
objectives: Enjoy a rhyming ocean story
Find facts about whales in an information book

weeks.topic: Folk tales from around the world
objectives: Listen to folk tales from different countries
Compare two tales

weeks.topic: Series books: following familiar characters
objectives: Read books with the same characters
Predict what the characters will do

weeks.topic: Reading words with endings in stories
objectives: Read words ending in -s, -es, -ing, -ed, -er and -est
Read contractions such as I'm and can't

weeks.topic: Comics and picture stories: speech bubbles
objectives: Read speech bubbles in comics
Follow the panels in the right order

weeks.topic: Recommending a favourite book to a friend
objectives: Explain why I like a book
Show a favourite page to a friend

weeks.topic: End-of-year reading assessment
objectives: Read aloud with accuracy and some fluency
Answer questions about events and characters

weeks.topic: Year 1 review: my reading journal
objectives: Share my favourite books of Year 1
Set a reading goal for the holidays
